description: A second-order theory has a general model if and only if each finite subset has a general model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.compactness.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Theory L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Satisfiable T ↔
    ∀ (F : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Sentence L)),
      ↑F ⊆ T → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.Satisfiable ↑F
